title: getSelectionMetrics
description: Backend RPC / stream helper: aggregates width, height, stroke, and corner radii of the current page selection for the Size PDF UI, including mixed flags and a list of items for the reorderable list.

returns.description: { ok, hasSelection, items[{id,name,w,h}], width, height, radius, rIndividual{tl,tr,br,bl}, strokeWeight, constrainProportions }. Numeric fields may be the string 'mixed'.
